convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 custom indicator, external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh), custom price enumerations, and complex smoothing method selection via external class CXMA

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Long closed when slope turns negative (DnValue>UpValue on bar[1])
Short closed when slope turns positive (UpValue>DnValue on bar[1])

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values = fixed lot size (abs value), positive values = share of deposit fraction. Default -0.1 means 0.1 fixed lots

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses two-bar comparison: bar[1] (previous) determines direction, bar[0] (current at SignalBar offset) determines crossover trigger. UpValue>DnValue on bar[1] confirms uptrend; UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] on the signal bar confirms the crossover just occurred (slope turning positive). Double-signal controversy removal: if both BUY_Open and SELL_Open are true simultaneously, all signals are zeroed out. SignalBar=0 forces signal recalculation every tick regardless of new bar. Recount flag causes retry on CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 must be reimplemented in Python - it uses CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements 10+ smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The Linear Regression Slope calculation with selectable smoothing is non-trivial. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be ported for BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions. The MM parameter conditional logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit share) must be replicated. The two-bar crossover detection pattern (bar[1] for direction, bar[0] for trigger) is subtle and must be preserved exactly. SignalBar=0 edge case (recalculate every tick) must be handled.
